name: forward-mcp
description: Unofficial guidance for an agent connected to Forward Networks' official MCP server (read-only questions about the digital twin). Not an official Forward document; needs no extra software.

interface.shortDescription: Use Forward's official MCP server well
interface.longDescription: How to ask Forward's official MCP server read-only questions about the network model: paths, devices, VLANs, VRFs, hosts, CVE exposure and NQE, with the working rules, the argument names and the errors to expect. Unofficial; not a Forward document.
defaultPrompt: Use Forward's MCP to check whether 10.0.0.1 can reach 10.0.0.2 on tcp/443 in network <id>.
